prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: Are  flight attendants angels? Because they hooked me up! https://t.co/vJFYqafBvF
Delta: #UchooseUs ✈ ❤ ✈ #WeChooseU #BonAppetit #Cheers *TMA

Customer: it’s hurtful that you allow your flight attendants and customer service employees believe that Discrimination is OK
Delta: Discrimination of any kind is never tolerated. Please DM flight confirmation so I may report this to our inflight leadership.  *HMB

Customer: Just had the nicest flight attendants ever 💜✈️  thanks
Delta: Thanks for the compliment for our crew Rachael; we're pretty proud of them also.  Glad to have you onboard; we ❤ you too!  *TJP

Customer: Much love to the  Flight attendants on flight DL3951. It was a vibe!!✊🏽💯🙏🏽👍🏽‼️🤘🏽
Delta: Thanks for your wonderful feedback, Jamison! We'll be sure to pass along the wonderful compliment. *AJC

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: praise):
"""My flight attendants on October 8 flight DL 1321 were incredible. Went overboard on quality customer service"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: Thanks for the shout‑out about our crew on DL1321! We're thrilled they delivered top‑notch service. We'll be sure to share your kind words with the team.
